name: io.github.tonyyang0504/yahoo_dsp-mcp
description: Yahoo DSP (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, pause_resume. Every tool maps to a documented en

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_YAHOO_DSP_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: DSP API client ID (DSP UI → your name → My Account → Activate; shown once). The JWT issuer is built as idb2b.dsp.dspapi.<client_id>, so enter the ID without that prefix.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_YAHOO_DSP_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: DSP API client secret shown with the client ID; it signs the HS256 client assertion.
